messages:
maria: Hey team — need to provision a new GPU node pool for low-latency inference in europe-west3. Target workload is real-time chat (p99 latency budget ~80ms), mostly short sequences. Thinking about SKU tradeoffs: A100 (40GB), L4 (24GB), or A10G (24GB). Also need guidance on spot/preemptible mix, autoscaler guardrails, and taints/tolerations.
alex: +1 for starting a thread. Quick thoughts: L4 is great for cost/latency for short-context models; A100 gives headroom for longer seqs/batching. If p99 is critical, prefer a small pool of A100s for guaranteed capacity and a larger burst pool of L4 spot nodes.
jun: agree. Also consider model quantization — if we can run int8, L4 looks even better. What's our expected qps and per-pod GPU request? e.g., 1 pod per GPU vs fractional gpus (MIG/partitioning)?
maria: target steady qps ~120rps, spike to 400rps. Each worker uses ~1 GPU and we batch small. No MIG planned initially. Prefer 1 pod -> 1 GPU for simplicity.
alex: then sizing: compute nodes with 4 GPUs each (n1-type or n2 with qps/CPU balancing). For europe-west3 quotas, check vCPU and GPUs. I'll run quota check.
quota-bot: Automated quota check: project has 120 A100 GPUs quota in europe-west3, 400 L4 GPUs quota. vCPU quota available: 3,200. No immediate quota blockers.
maria: awesome. For autoscaler guardrails — want node pool min=2, max=25 for the A100 reserved pool; burst pool (L4 spot) min=0, max=80. We need eviction fallback: route to L4 pool if A100 saturated.
jun: implement nodeSelector/affinity + taint on A100 pool: "gpu-type=a100:NoSchedule" and toleration on critical pods. For fallback use topology-aware routing in runtime or use a smart router that prefers a100 label.
sre-bot: Note: when using spot nodes, set max surge=1 and enable pod disruption budgets for stateless workers. Also set node termination handler and graceful eviction = 120s.
alex: autoscaler config snippet (for CA-gke example):
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v1
kind: ClusterAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleDown:
    delayAfterAdd: 10m
  balanceSimilarNodeGroups: true
```
Also set scale-up from 0 cooldown to 30s for burst pool.
maria: Can we add preemptible mix policy (e.g., 70% spot, 30% reserved) on burst pool? I want some baseline reserved capacity for critical traffic.
jun: yes — create two burst node pools: burst-reserved-l4 (min=2,max=20, preemptible=false) and burst-spot-l4 (min=0,max=60, preemptible=true). Use taints to route non-critical pods to spot.
alex: ops checklist:
- create IAM service account for node pool
- ensure GPU drivers/containers image init (driver installer DaemonSet)
- label nodepools: gpu-type, billing-tier
- enable GKE node local SSDs if needed for cache
- update helm values for runtime to prefer a100 label
maria: DB/egress concerns: need to reserve egress IPs for the A100 pool — latency-sensitive traffic must go through NAT gateway with low jitter. Also open firewall for model-weights download staging.
sre-bot: Filing infra ticket to provision egress IPs and request regional quota bump if needed.

maria: last ask — can one of you file the actual GCP quota request for A100 GPUs and a service account setup? I'm going to write a short runbook once pools exist. :thumbsup:
alex: I'll file the quota request and create the node pool terraform plan. Posting plan link when ready.
jun: I'll own runtime helm updates and taints/tolerations. :rocket:
maria: thanks — leaving this thread here. Will follow up in the PR.
